timing: Paid per completed donation via prepaid debit card; $55 extra bonus after second donation
eligibility: 18-69, 110+ lbs, good health; valid photo ID, proof of address, SSN; pass health screening; twice weekly max with at least one day between donations
steps: Sign up at kedplasma.com and find a center (69+ US centers)
Bring valid photo ID, proof of address, and SSN
Pass screening and physical exam on first visit (2-3 hours)
Complete your second donation to trigger the extra $55 new-donor bonus
KEDPlasma pays a flat rate regardless of weight — same pay at your weight as anyone else
catches: New-donor bonuses are paid across your first 6 donations; amounts vary by center and season.

biggest_catch: The headline bonuses are one-time and location-specific — regular flat-rate pay is $35-$70 per visit, strong if you donate steadily, unremarkable for a single visit.

repeatable.cadence: Up to twice per week with at least one day between donations, ongoing, as long as you keep passing screening — the new-donor bonus is one-time per person; KEDrewards points keep accruing on every visit.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: up to twice per week indefinitely. New-donor bonus across first ~6 donations is one-time; KEDrewards points accrue on every visit (repeatable).

who_pays: KEDPlasma compensates you per completed donation; the official promo page doesn't name the payment instrument, so ask your center whether it's a prepaid card or another method.
who_qualifies: You must be 18-69, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring a valid photo ID, proof of address, and SSN — then pass the health screening. The $55-after-2nd-donation bonus is for new donors only. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: KEDPlasma operates 69+ centers in 23 states — normally open, but the network is much smaller than the big chains, so check one is near you first. New-donor bonus schedules vary by center and season — confirm the current offer at your center before your first visit.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the health screening and finish the donation. The $55 bonus requires completing your second donation as a new donor.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes 2-3 hours with screening and physical before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, travel and waiting — all unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Paid per completed donation — but the exact payment method and timing aren't spelled out on KEDPlasma's official promo page, so confirm with your center before you donate.
